rationale: The message reports completed probing results for the flatten and fmt commands, including concrete output behaviors and option effects. It is primarily delivering results, with observed factual findings as a secondary function.

evidence.text:
Probed flatten: default output labels aligned with two spaces: `name  Alice
age    30
#
`; each record separator line, no trailing # after final.
-n labels indices padded (`0   name`). -c 3 truncates to first 3 chars + `...` (so 6 chars output). -s @ emits @ newline between records.
fmt default preserves CSV; --quote-always quotes all fields.
